landing_fin_sub: Turn an idea into rules, see which portfolio comes out and compare it with the S&P 500, matchday by matchday.
landing_aviso_ejemplo: Paper strategies, with no real money. This scene uses fictional figures; the companies are illustrations, not recommendations.
landing_resumen_titulo: How Vennett works, in one scene
landing_resumen: At the New York close, a snapshot of the market is taken. You write an idea, it becomes rules that filter the companies, the ones that pass are ranked by what you value, five make the portfolio and the market compares it with the S&P 500 matchday by matchday, alongside other strategies that start from the same snapshot.
landing_foto_frase: Everyone starts from the same snapshot.
landing_tesis: I’m looking for profitable companies that sell more every year, with little debt, that aren’t expensive.
landing_pista_per: Move the maximum P/E and the film recalculates.
landing_pesos_ceja: Among those that pass, what you value most
landing_cartera_sub: 20% each · at most 2 per sector · reviewed on day 1 of each month
